info.name: Senaa API
info.description: Senaa marketplace API — Sprint 1 (authentication and registration). See docs/sprint-1-backend.md for the full backend specification.

request.description: Creates the account with email_verified_at = NULL and sends a 6-digit code (purpose=register) to the email. No token is returned here — call Verify Email next with the code (check storage/logs/laravel.log locally, since MAIL_MAILER=log) to receive the login token. phone accepts +970 or +972; it is normalized to +970XXXXXXXXX before storage.

response.name: 201 Success
422 Validation error (duplicate email)

request.description:
One request for both wizard steps (screens 4+5). personal_photo_path and id_selfie_path must be real paths already returned by POST /api/uploads — call that first for each file. id_selfie_path is admin-only and is never returned in any response.

craft_id: pick from GET /api/services. For the "other" option in the craft picker, omit craft_id and send custom_craft_name instead (free text) — the backend normalizes it (strips diacritics, unifies alef/hamza forms) and either reuses a matching existing craft or creates a new one automatically, then stores its id as craft_id. Exactly one of craft_id / custom_craft_name is required.

bio is required, minimum 10 characters.

request.description: purpose=register on success sets email_verified_at, issues the Sanctum login token (auto-saved to {{token}} by the Tests script here), and logs the user in. purpose=reset on success returns a short-lived reset_token instead (not a login token) — used by Reset Password. Get the real code from storage/logs/laravel.log locally (MAIL_MAILER=log).

response.name: 200 Success (register)
422 Wrong or expired code

request.description: Subject to §6.3: 45-second cooldown and 3 sends/hour per email+purpose. Wrong verify-email attempts never count against this limit — only actual sends do.

response.name: 200 Success
429 Cooldown / limit reached

request.description: email_verified_at is checked before anything else — an unverified account gets a 403 with a fresh code sent, not a credentials error. 5 consecutive wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes (423). remember=true issues a 30-day token instead of the default 24-hour one. Auto-saves the token to {{token}} on success.

response.name: 200 Success
401 Wrong credentials (generic)
403 Unverified email
423 Account locked

request.description: Protected: requires auth:sanctum + verified.email + active.account. Returns the authenticated user's data.

request.description: Protected. Revokes only the token used for this request (not every session/device).

response.name: 200 Success

request.description: Always returns the same neutral message, whether or not the email is registered — never reveals account existence. If registered, a purpose=reset code is sent (check storage/logs/laravel.log locally). Next step: Verify Email with purpose=reset to get a reset_token, then Reset Password.

response.name: 200 Success (same for any email)

request.description: reset_token comes from Verify Email's purpose=reset response, is valid for 10 minutes, and single-use. On success, every existing token/session for the user is revoked — they must log in again.

response.name: 200 Success
422 Invalid or expired token
200 Success
200 Success
404 Governorate not found
200 Success
200 Success (empty until seeded via admin dashboard)

request.description: Open to guests — used during the registration wizard to upload photos/documents before the account exists. The returned `path` is what gets sent as e.g. `personal_photo_path` in the registration request body. Max 10 MB; JPG/PNG/PDF only (checked by actual content, not extension).

response.name: 201 Success
422 Validation error (missing file / wrong type / too large)

request.description: Protected. Partial update — send only the fields you want to change. Editable: full_name, governorate_id + area_id (together), and role-specific fields — bio/personal_photo_path (craftsman), description (institution/contractor), main_specialization/workers_count (contractor). Locked fields (national_id, commercial_registration_number, craft_id, license_file_path) are silently ignored even if sent — they simply don't exist in this endpoint's accepted fields.

request.description: Admin only. reason is mandatory. Unlike approve/reject, this sets users.status = suspended (blocks login for the whole account, not just the trust badge) and immediately revokes all of the user's active tokens. Logged in account_reviews.
